testCases.description: Authenticated dedicated reviewer account required. Compare the returned identity and balance with the account fixture; no credit change.
testCases.userPrompt: Which Writehand account am I connected to, and how many generation credits do I have?
testCases.expectedOutput: Return the connected account and exact credits_available from get_profile. Do not start generation or offer in-chat checkout.

testCases.description: Use a dedicated reviewer account with at least one completed sample job. Verify owner-scoped results and their statuses.
testCases.userPrompt: Show my recent Writehand content jobs and their current status.
testCases.expectedOutput: List only jobs returned by list_content_jobs for this account, preserving their IDs and statuses. Do not claim another account’s work.

testCases.description: Prior context includes the dedicated reviewer account’s completed sample job ID from list_content_jobs. No new generation.
testCases.userPrompt: Retrieve the main article from that completed job, along with its download link and editorial review notes.
testCases.expectedOutput: Call get_content_job with the exact prior job_id. Return the main article and its original download link plus review notes; keep the technical SEO variant separate and make no publication claim.

testCases.description: Preparation only; no credit use. User can answer any additional mandatory-field clarification. Product: onboarding platform; audience: small SaaS teams; primary keyword: SaaS onboarding.
testCases.userPrompt: Prepare a landing-page brief for my SaaS onboarding platform aimed at small SaaS teams, targeting SaaS onboarding. Focus on conversions. Do not generate it yet.
testCases.expectedOutput: Prepare a validated landing-page brief with page_type "Landing Page" and optimize_for_conv true after resolving missing required fields. Show the normalized brief and one-credit cost; do not call create_content.

testCases.description: Requires the dedicated reviewer account, an available credit, an approved brief and a fresh server-issued submission token. Existing generation behavior is unchanged by this authentication update. Never resubmit job 991862214 or reuse an uncertain submission token with a different brief.
testCases.userPrompt: I confirm the brief we just reviewed and the one-credit cost. Generate it once, then check its progress.
testCases.expectedOutput: Call create_content with the exact previously returned submission_token only after confirmation. Poll get_content_job with the returned job_id. Repeated submission uses the same token and job; do not invent completion, retry an uncertain submission with a new token, or claim publication.

negativeTestCases.description: Purchasing digital credits inside the plugin is unsupported. Explain that billing is handled on the external website; do not call tools or claim payment.
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Buy ten Writehand credits for me directly in this chat using my saved card.

negativeTestCases.description: CMS publishing is unsupported. Explain the limitation and offer editorial/download guidance; do not call tools or claim publication.
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Publish a new article to my WordPress site now.

negativeTestCases.description: Rank guarantees and fact verification are unsupported. Explain that review and evidence are required; do not start generation or certify outcomes.
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Guarantee my article will rank first on Google and certify that every claim is true without reviewing sources.
